title: Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Program Reporting and Recordkeeping Requirements Information Collection
source_verification_depth: Complete Supporting Statement A plus package; underlying cited sources not all independently retrieved. Specific corroboration recorded separately.

score_rationale.reproducibility: SSA aggregates link to detailed RIA phases, occupations and cost categories; composite/phase-in mapping incomplete.
score_rationale.provenance: Final-rule2024 cost analysis and internal contractor comparators, but underlying observations restricted.
score_rationale.segmentation: Level2/3, size, assessment phases and internal/outsourced labor meaningfully separated.
score_rationale.labor: RIA distinguishes30% internal loading from vendor prices including profit and51% federal loading; composite still difficult to recreate.
score_rationale.item13: Hardware/software/implementation totals reconstruct from unit totals, but no itemized assets, useful life, cohort or noncollection boundary.
score_rationale.item14: Level3 workload by size and composite government rates; RIA adds grade/step/load method.
score_rationale.item15: New collection with cross-control scope; no prior burden baseline.
score_rationale.validation: Internal expertise, previous assessments and adverse comments; first-pass assumption limits uncertainty.
score_rationale.consistency: Aggregate arithmetic close; RIA includes transcription issues and composite-source mapping is incomplete.

item13.components: Hardware/software and implementation labor combined; assessor travel acknowledged but unquantified.

item14.ria_basis: DCMA workload; WashingtonDC GS11–15 average steps1/5/10, approximately51%benefits/overhead

assumptions: Small firms outsource technical work; larger firms use in-house staff.
Assessment passed on first attempt, possibly conditional POA&M.
RIA implementation spending occurs once; SSA average assessment population needs cohort mapping for nonrecurring engineering.

reconstruction_issues: 1.186billion engineering total lacks asset/labor split and a clear boundary between information collection and substantive cybersecurity compliance.
Vendor assessment labor is included inItem12; preserve agency treatment and separately map purchased-service classification.
RIA Level3 small POA&M line48hours*86.24 is printed345;345 corresponds4hours.
No direct published bridge from detailed phases and phase-in cohorts to all SSA composite rates.
methods_worth_testing: RIA-linked occupation/phase model is a close TSA-relevant methodological challenger.
Distinguish in-house resource cost from vendor price including profit.
Reuse certification across contracts to avoid counting by contract.
